contents.text: {"answer":"Yes. Other owners reported rear backup cameras becoming inoperable when tailgate wiring broke or severed, matching the failure described in this complaint. One earlier report specifically attributed worn-through wires to opening and closing the two-way tailgate; another described a wiring-harness stress point severing the electrical connection and leaving no camera image.","scope":"answered","recheck":false,"citations":[{"kind":"complaint","id":"11443328","quote":"Rear camera is not working due to frayed and/or disconnected wires."},{"kind":"earlier_complaint","id":"11437880","quote":"Opening and closing of the two-way tailgate, over time, have worn through the wires."},{"kind":"earlier_complaint","id":"11437880","quote":"The wires connected to the rear backup camera in the tailgate have broken due to a design defect, making the camera inoperable."},{"kind":"earlier_complaint","id":"11350162","quote":"STRESS POINT IN HARNESS SEVERS ELECTRICAL CONNECTION LEADING TO NO IMAGE FROM CAMERA."}]}
